_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.1 (part 02): news segments on the PokéGear radio.
tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_radio.py turns this into src/data/hoenn_radio_segments.h; src/hoenn_radio.c plays it.
Each segment plays before its station's own broadcast (in the intro of oak_talk), in this order, when every condition in 'if' holds.
station  oak_talk, pokedex_show, pokemon_music, lucky_channel, buenas_password, unown, places_and_people, lets_all_sing, poke_flute, rocket, hoenn_sound
if       conditions, the hint engine's format (npc_hints.json): {flag}, {not_flag}, {var, min|below}, {stamps_min}, {badges_min}, {caught}, {not_caught}, ...
lines    1-3 fixed lines, at most 31 characters each (the radio box); or
builder  a C function (HoennRadioBuilder, include/hoenn_2_1.h) that writes its own lines and returns how many (0 = nothing today)
heard    optional FLAG_HOENN_ flag set the first time it plays (the Seeker's Journal reads these)
note     who added it and why (copied into the generated table)
Limits: at most 6 segment lines per broadcast, fewer on stations whose own show is long (lucky_channel leaves 2); one builder per broadcast. Rows that don't fit wait.
Two builder tracks add rows in parallel (hoenn-docs/2.1-tracks.md): track A appends to 'track_a', track B to 'track_b'. They play after 'segments' (2.0's and part 02's), A before B.

segments.note: 2.0 part 35b: EUSINE's tracking notes say where the uncaught beast is
2.0 part 28: the Unown Cipher's signal at the Ruins of Alph
2.1 part 02: news after you beat Wallace, until Brendan & May

track_a.note: 2.1-07: today's swarm, on PROF. OAK's POKéDEX show
